name: Stayed at the bedside with a pulse to spare

props.ChoiceTitle: Stayed at the bedside with a pulse to spare
props.ChoiceText: Where another would have flagged through the long hours, you kept your place at the bedside, cheerful enough to hold fear from settling over the room.
props.ChoiceBio: Your warmth proved itself not only in pleasure, but in the life you kept burning in others when strength ran thin.

0.TargetText: Someone from that sickroom still remembers how your liveliness kept despair from settling in fully.

0.Amount: You learned that buoyancy can be a form of medicine in rooms that would otherwise go dark.
